payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): a production advisory with no non-breaking fix carries a reviewed, dated exception and a registry finding for the real fix
payload.notes: External drift (published 2026-10-30T23:09Z). No production pattern comes from a request: the two globs expand the committed data-source entity patterns and cacache's own fixed patterns. The dev graphs (nx, eslint, jest and others) carry minimatch 3.x to 10.x at moderate, below the root-full floor. Plan: the same two changes as the glob finding of the same day (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4, SUPPLY-MEDIUM-043): the typeorm 1.x migration as its own change, and cacache on glob >=14.0.2, which brings minimatch ^11.0.2. The exception GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 expires 2026-12-01.
